source: GLM-5.3's MoE cut per expert at its TP8 statics (the circuit glm53-moe-per-expert): the router's slots, one output field a slot; each slot's w13 and w2 rows and scales read from tables registered one expert a row (EmbeddingRead_v1 at the leaf the router's committed slot index names); per-expert GEMMs over the rows read. Units a token are 75 layers x 8 slots on each of 8 ranks; ANDs and staged k_log as circuit-check reports them at those statics; output bits from each Definition's outputs (a read's h, H 16-bit words, and ok; a GEMM's N bf16 words). model_overhead is the marginal end to end, a k27 block's 7.9 ms on the H200 scaled by witness bits, over a token's MACs at the dense FP8 peak: priced from staged k_log, not measured. The Definitions and the circuit are built; GLM-5.3 does not serve this cut yet.
